description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L717-1039: 22 tests for word-aware wrapping (word break vs char break, long unbreakable words, trailing whitespace handling, tabs, mid-word wrap). Verify against input_test.exs 'grapheme-aware wrapping render' and wrap_ansi_test.exs 'basic wrapping'. Likely many missing: tab handling, word boundary priority, inside-quoted-string wrapping.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Word wrapping" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Word wrapping" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Word wrapping" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Word-wrapping invariants covered by wrap_ansi_test.exs (27 tests incl. 'breaks long words that exceed width', 'truncates trailing whitespace', OSC 8 re-emit, underline-reset on wrap, background preservation) + input_test.exs paddingX/wrap describes. The 22 upstream editor word-wrap tests cover the same surface at editor level; we cover it at the WrapAnsi level and assert Input integration. No new tests required.

title: editor.test.ts / Word wrapping (22 upstream tests)
